description: Read-only. runtime_session_ids accepts at most 200 external runtime ids, optionally filtered by vendor and inclusive ISO since/until event window. With no ids, vendor plus since plus until are required; enumeration returns at most 200 canonical groups and the 201st qualifying group yields status unknown:bounded, overflow true, sessions_at_least 201 (a lower bound). Each full live sibling group contributes one usage-bearing eligible local row, ranked by event_count, last_event_at, id. Claude keeps the first occurrence of each message_id and groups by usage_json.model; legacy missing ids emit dedupe_unavailable:N events. Missing models stay in the literal unknown bucket and emit model_unavailable:N events; their model is not recorded. Codex uses the last cumulative total, or the difference of the last total at/before until and the last total strictly before since. Decreases are disclosed, never summed or clamped. Unreported categories stay null. Thinking is a breakdown of output; cache TTL, speed and service tier are retained. Per-session page caps produce partial plus counted advisories, never refusal. Unknown harness has adapter null plus notes. last_poll_at is newest completed source import or null with last_poll_at_unavailable. Returns sessions with runtime_session_id, vendor, session_id, by_model, first_event_at, last_event_at, event_count, usage_event_count, adapter, adapter_notes, last_poll_at, status, meter supported/unsupported, sibling_rows_resolved, advisories; top-level status, not_found and advisories. Claude local and Codex local are metered; Claude cloud/pushed/history and other Codex sources are not separate meters. Platform inference and embeddings are out of scope. Codex plan-limit availability remains unmeasured. No pricing or consumer writes.
embedding_description: Read windowed, message-deduped runtime session usage by model, with bounded ledger enumeration, sibling resolution and explicit partial/unknown telemetry.
